clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker seeks help for his missing crew. His introductory appeal sends travelers across the sea to Auberdine, where the dwarven expedition met Darkshore's wild, shadowy coast.

Darnassus, the grand night elven capital, is home to dwarven researchers from Ironforge studying Kalimdor's ancient mysteries. Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker sent an excavation party across the water to Darkshore to unearth artifacts of antiquity. Weeks have passed without a message or progress report, and Greywhisker fears his field crew has met dangers they could not survive alone.

Greywhisker laments that many in the Alliance dismiss dwarven archaeology as an eccentric hobby. Findings in Khaz Modan have convinced his colleagues that an ancient, terrifying force threatens Azeroth from Lordaeron to Kalimdor. The work in Darkshore's ruins is more than scholarship: it seeks to understand historic cataclysms and the deep-seated menaces buried beneath ancient soil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: How nice it is to see an adventurer interested in the great archeological wonders of our world.

Oftentimes our work is dismissed as mere hobby by our friends in the Alliance. But what many fail to realize is that recent discoveries in Khaz Modan have proven that a great and powerful force threatens all of Azeroth, from Lordaeron to Kalimdor.
I am most worried about my crew that I sent to Darkshore. They haven't sent word in weeks.
Travel to Auberdine and look for a clue as to their whereabouts.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm so glad Chief Archeologist Greywhisker sent for us....
